text.text_excerpt: I thought this was a GREAT choice for my recent stay in New Orleans. They have a lot of different room options (suite styles, etc) and the prices were more than reasonable. You can find good deals through several websites, but I paid for the room online (up front purchase) directly through their website and still got a great deal (about $70 a night). What makes this place even better, is how VERY close it is to Bourbon St and Jackson Square. It makes it very easy to head out for your day time adventures and your night time of forgotten memories. LOL The room I had was clean, small TV but I only watched it early in the morning, or extremely late at night when I couldn't pass out (to many r...

I stayed in one of the suites with my mom and 3 of her best friends (5 people total). The room was perfect for us! We really enjoyed our stay here. The Prince Conti (pronounced con-tie in case you're wondering) is located 2 blocks away from Bourbon St. It's locations was very convent to everything we wanted to do. As for the room, it had to full beds and a pull out couch. The beds were comfy however as the youngest I was left with the couch. I have to say I slept very well! The size of the room was just right for us. The staff was so friendly! Ava at the front desk was a riot and she really took care of us. But everyone was so kind and helpful. This place has valet parking for $30 dollars...

Not my favorite place to stay in New Orleans, but a decent hotel with decent prices. They're located within walking distance of bourbon and the quarter, they're clean, and seem pretty secure. They also have their own parking area, but it is *limited* and so it may be a good idea to call ahead and see if they have space for you. The room was pretty consistent with other hotels in the area. It's going to be smaller than most cities, the bathroom will be tiny, but when you're in New Orleans you're there for the city, not for where you're sleeping.
